findings.evidence: `indecProjRepToSimpleRep_app_basis_of_length_ne_zero` states only that `... (indecProjRepBasis ... p) = 0` when `p.length ≠ 0`; the same overclaim appears in the module docstring’s Implementation notes.
findings.fix: Describe the result as killing every positive-length path basis vector (and, by linearity, their span), or formally define the corresponding arrow-generated subrepresentation before making an arrow-ideal claim.
findings.issue: The declaration docstring and module implementation notes say the morphism “kills” or its kernel “contains the arrow ideal,” but the stated theorem only concerns positive-length path basis vectors in the projective representation; no path-algebra ideal or identification with one appears in the statement.

summary: The documentation inaccurately identifies a family of positive-length path basis vectors with the arrow ideal inside the kernel of a representation morphism.
